تصالحت (form VI)
# تَصَالَحْتُ (taṣālaḥtu) /ta.sˤaː.laħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# تَصَالَحْتَ (taṣālaḥta) /ta.sˤaː.laħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# تَصَالَحْتِ (taṣālaḥti) /ta.sˤaː.laħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# تَصَالَحَتْ (taṣālaḥat) /ta.sˤaː.la.ħat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
